content.title: Boston Beer price target lowered to $220 from $250 at Citi
content.summary: Citi lowered the firm’s price target on Boston Beer (SAM) to $220 from $250 and keeps a Neutral rating on the shares. The firm adjusted targets in the beverages, household and personal care sector as part of its 2026 outlook. Citi is shifting from a bullish stance on the non-alcoholic beverage space throughout 2025 toward favoring the household and personal care names.
